name: better-lgu-design
description: Shared design system and civic patterns for community-built Philippine LGU portals, drawn from Better Naguilian, BetterSolano, BetterLB and betterlocalgov: OKLCH tokens with dark and high-contrast modes, shadcn/ui variants, a Kapwa token crosswalk, forking config with LGU-type labels, sourced facts, Citizen's Charter service pages, languages and accessibility rules.
